rationale: No existing spec covers the org passcode access-control behavior (organizationPasscodeForbidden latch + warning banner). ingestion-config.spec.js covers navigation/copy/doc-links only, ingestionTokens.spec.js covers the IAM token CRUD surface, and serviceAccount.spec.js covers service-account lifecycle without ever calling GET /{org}/passcode. The RUM specs touched by the diff are unrelated (CDN dataflow skip-on-no-init) and provide no passcode coverage. A brand-new GeneralTests spec is required and must be registered in ci_matrix.json's GeneralTests run_files.
